title: An etale module sheaf vanishing on a covering family is zero
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\{\varphi_i:V_i\to X\}_{i\in I}$ be a covering family of $X$ in its small etale site $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], that is, a finite or arbitrary jointly surjective family of etale morphisms; for example a finite family of open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion] whose images cover $X$, and, when $X$ is empty, the empty family. Let $F$ be a sheaf of modules on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and write $F|_{V_i}$ for its restriction to the slice site $X_{\mathrm{et}}/V_i$, whose sections over an etale $X$-morphism $W\to V_i$ are $F(W)$. If every restriction $F|_{V_i}$ is the zero sheaf, then $F$ is the zero sheaf on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$.

source.place: Proof, Step 5: “A sheaf vanishing on a cover is zero”

mathlib_searches.results: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.zero_of_zero_cover (Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Cover/Open), plus generic sheaf local-generator declarations; the returned zero_of_zero_cover is only for sections of the structure sheaf, not arbitrary etale module sheaves.

mathlib_searches.results: TopCat.Presheaf.IsSheaf.isSheafOpensLeCover and generic gluing declarations, plus Scheme.zero_of_zero_cover for the structure sheaf; no theorem for arbitrary etale module sheaves and their open restrictions.
